context.purpose: Show a careful, unhyped first step: Hemant reads the back of the pack and the study page before he adds a spoon to the family's atta. Trust comes from reading, not from selling.
context.settingAndCamera: Pune flat living and dining room with a small mandir shelf, a dining table and a wall clock. Pack, a printed study page and a notebook on the table. Warm lamp and daylight mix. Handheld at the table.
context.disclaimers: D3 applies as well as D1, D2 and D4, because the study is named.
watchOuts: Hemant says nothing about his own health or any result. He reads, adds the spoon and sits down to the same meal.

cast.name: Hemant
cast.description: Hemant, 53, Pune, runs a hardware shop. Half-sleeve cotton shirt, reading glasses, steel watch. Cautious and thoughtful, speaks English with a Marathi lilt.

cast.name: Anjali
cast.description: His wife Anjali, 49, in a cotton kurta set with a dupatta, brings the chapatis to the table.

shots.visual: Hemant holds the pack up to camera and taps the back label.
shots.vo: First thing I did was read the back of the pack.

shots.visual: A real Amazon review card slides in with a Verified Purchase badge. Hemant glances at it. Use a real, cleared review on this theme: reading the label and the details carefully.
shots.vo: One customer wrote on Amazon: "[real review, verbatim]".
shots.onScreenText: Customer review on Amazon · Verified Purchase

shots.visual: Evening at home. Anjali holds up the pack and asks a question. Hemant takes it from her and reads the label.
shots.vo: Anjali asked, what is this? I said, let's read about it first.

shots.visual: He flips the printed study page and points at the journal name.
shots.vo: So I read about the study too. I like to know what's going into my family's food.

shots.visual: Top-down at home. One tablespoon of flour into the atta, hand mixes.
shots.vo: After that it was easy. One tablespoon of the Jackfruit365 flour in the atta.

shots.visual: Anjali puts chapatis, a vegetable bhaji, a bowl of varan and a little rice on the table. Hemant smiles. The plates are the same as always.
shots.vo: Same chapatis, same thali. Nothing on the plate is different.

shots.visual: Hemant and Anjali at the table. He gives her a quiet nod.
shots.vo: Now it's just part of dinner. Nothing dramatic.

shots.visual: Hold on the claim card with the pack.
shots.vo: Clinically tested. 100% green jackfruit, nothing else.
shots.onScreenText: Helps control blood sugar levels* · 100% green jackfruit. Nothing else.

shots.vo: Jackfruit365. Available on Amazon, where you can read the reviews.
shots.onScreenText: Pack shot. Available on Amazon. Disclaimer lines. · Read the reviews on Amazon
